nodes.label: House Cladding Wood Texture
nodes.description: Flat, evenly-lit photo texture of light natural oak wood grain, roughly 900x650px landscape. Warm honey/pale-tan colour with low contrast, horizontal grain running left-to-right, subtle cathedral figure in the upper half and a few small dark knots. No visible plank seams, bevels or shadow gradients, so it reads as a single continuous wood surface rather than pre-composed cladding boards; tiling suitability is moderate (horizontal repeat is plausible, vertical repeat may show the cathedral figure). Intended as the timber/cladding albedo map for the cabin walls in the diorama.

nodes.label: Timber Cladding Material
nodes.rationale: The diorama direction is a light product-render cabin with base colours only, where the user textures timber themselves; this light oak texture is the swappable colour map for the cabin's exterior cladding, chosen for its warm low-contrast tone that stays readable under simple PCF shadows without competing with the water-filtration focus.
